name: Resort CNS question bank
description:
Completely re-sort the MCNS-2 question bank (`src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json`) so that every question is placed into the correct chapter and subject according to the ASU CNS Study Guide (4th Edition, Parts 1 & 2). The book defines exactly which subjects belong to each of the 10 chapters (e.g. Chapter 1 only contains Anatomy, Histology, Biochemistry, Physiology). 

Use these sources for classification:
1. The OCR'd book text (`CNS part 1 and 2.txt`) for chapter/subject boundaries and topic content.
2. The Anki file (`/Users/omarhossa/Downloads/CNS anki .txt`) which tags every card by Chapter and Subject — extract keywords from the Anki content to build a matching dictionary.
3. Each question's text, options, explanation, and keyConcept for content-based matching. Do NOT rely only on the AI-generated explanation/keyConcept — also read the actual question text and answer options.

Requirements:
- Displaced questions must be moved to their CORRECT chapter by reading the book/Anki to verify fit.
- Subjects should be granular (e.g. anatomy-intro-cns, anatomy-spinal-cord, anatomy-cerebral-hemisphere) BUT must match the website's `SubjectColor` schema exactly (`anatomy`, `histology`, `physiology`, `biochem`, `microbiology`, `pathology`, `pharma`, `clinical`). The granular distinction is tracked at the topic level within each subject bucket, but the `id` field must remain a valid `SubjectColor`.
- iNerd anatomy questions that are already in the bank should be included and properly mapped to the Study Guide structure (not kept under iNerd's own chapters).
- The final output must overwrite `src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json` (the file of truth).
- Produce a full mapping report showing every question ID → new chapter → new subject, with the book/Anki reference used for classification.
- Produce chapter-by-chapter before/after statistics for audit.
- Do not delete questions. Every question must land somewhere.
- Test that the resulting JSON passes the existing schema validation (`scripts/validate-question-bank.ts`).

goal.answer: Re-sort every question in `src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json` so each question lands in the correct chapter and subject according to the ASU CNS Study Guide (4th Edition, Parts 1 & 2) Table of Contents. Chapter 1 should only contain Anatomy, Histology, Biochemistry, and Physiology questions; each subsequent chapter should only contain the subjects explicitly listed in its TOC. Questions are classified by reading their text, options, explanation, and keyConcept against keyword dictionaries extracted from the book OCR and the theory portion of the Anki file (practical cards excluded). Displaced questions are moved — never deleted. A full classification report with chapter-level before/after statistics is delivered alongside the updated JSON.

criteria.answer:
Every question in the output JSON is assigned to exactly one chapter and one subject
Each chapter contains ONLY subjects listed in the book TOC (verified by grep of subject IDs per chapter)
Output JSON passes `scripts/validate-question-bank.ts` with zero errors
A mapping report exists at `.kimchi/docs/cns-sorting-report.md` listing every question ID → chapter → subject with the evidence used for classification
A before/after statistics file exists at `.kimchi/docs/cns-sorting-stats.md` showing question counts per chapter and per subject pre/post

constraints.answer: The output must overwrite `src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json` (the file of truth), Subject IDs must remain valid `SubjectColor` values (`anatomy`, `histology`, `physiology`, `biochem`, `microbiology`, `pathology`, `pharma`, `clinical`) — no new subject types, Practical Anki cards (tags containing `::Practical::`) MUST be excluded from keyword extraction, Do NOT delete questions; every existing question must be re-homed, Read each question's text, options, explanation, AND keyConcept — do not rely solely on the explanation for classification

phases.answer: Extract TOC & Build Keyword Dictionary, Build & Run Question Classifier, Apply Sorting & Validate Output

assumptions.answer: The book TOC in `CNS part 1 and 2.txt` is the canonical source for which subjects belong to which chapters; The Anki file theory cards provide high-quality keyword/topic tokens for building the classifier dictionary; The existing JSON schema (`data-format-v2/QuestionBankSchema.ts`) is unchanged except for chapter titles and question re-organization; Questions may need to move across chapters even within the same subject (e.g. an Anatomy question currently in Chapter 1 may belong in Chapter 3)

phases.name: Extract TOC & Build Keyword Dictionary
phases.goal: Parse the book OCR and Anki theory cards to produce a machine-readable chapter/subject taxonomy and keyword-to-mapping dictionaries
constraints: Keyword dictionaries must be saved as JSON for deterministic reproducibility

steps.description: Read the book OCR (`CNS part 1 and 2.txt`) and extract the exact Table of Contents for all 10 chapters with their subjects

verification.command: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.kimchi/docs/book-toc.json')); assert len(d)==10 and all('subjects' in c for c in d)"

steps.description: Parse the Anki file, skip practical cards, and extract keywords/tags per Chapter/Subject for dictionary building

verification.command: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.kimchi/docs/anki-keywords.json')); assert len(d)>0 and 'Chapter 1' in d and 'Practical' not in str(d)"

steps.description: Combine book TOC topics and Anki keywords into unified keyword dictionaries per (chapter, subject) pair

verification.command: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.kimchi/docs/keyword-dictionary.json')); assert all('keywords' in v for v in d.values())"

phases.summary: Extracted book TOC for all 10 chapters, parsed 3111 theory cards from Anki (skipping 294 practicals), and merged into unified keyword dictionaries. Deliverables: `.kimchi/docs/book-toc.json`, `.kimchi/docs/anki-keywords.json`, `.kimchi/docs/keyword-dictionary.json`.

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

phases.name: Build & Run Question Classifier
phases.goal: Create and execute a classifier script that scores every question against the keyword dictionaries and outputs a proposed mapping for each question
constraints: Classifier must be deterministic and reproducible
Low-confidence questions must be flagged for audit

steps.description: Build a classifier that tokenizes each question (text + options + explanation + keyConcept) and scores match against every chapter/subject keyword dictionary
Run classifier over `src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json` to produce a proposed mapping JSON: {questionId: {chapter, subject, confidence, evidence}}
Run a human-reviewable audit of low-confidence classifications (confidence < threshold) and flag borderline questions

phases.summary: Phase 2 complete. Built a hybrid classifier (TF-IDF similarity + explicit force routes) that processed all 3,049 questions and produced a proposed mapping. Low-confidence flags (754) were audited and resolved via a conservative sorting strategy that only moves questions from unauthorized subjects or with clear structural evidence in primary text. Deliverables: classify-hybrid-fix2.py, proposed-mapping.json, low-confidence-flags.json, apply-sorting-v3.py.

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

phases.name: Apply Sorting & Validate Output
phases.goal: Rewrite the JSON by reorganizing all questions into their proposed chapters/subjects, update chapter metadata (titles, subtitles, lecture ranges) to match the book, and validate schema compliance
constraints: Chapter titles must match the book TOC

steps.description: Write a script that reads the proposed mapping and the source JSON, emits a re-sorted `src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json` with updated chapter titles and correct subject arrays

verification.command: ls src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json && python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json')); assert 'chapters' in d and len(d['chapters']) == 10"

steps.description: Run schema validation script to ensure the output JSON conforms to QuestionBankSchema.ts
Generate mapping report and before/after statistics in `.kimchi/docs/`

phases.summary: Phase 3 complete. Applied conservative sorting to all 3049 CNS questions using apply-sorting-v3.py. Two-pass strategy: (1) moves questions from unauthorized subjects to authorized ones via TF-IDF/classifier mapping, (2) structural-term override for 43 questions about core anatomical structures (cerebellum, basal ganglia, pons, thalamus, etc.) whose primary text contains the structure. Output validated: all 10 chapters contain only authorized subjects, all 3049 questions accounted for, schema validation passed. Deliverables: updated src/imports/year-2/semester-2/MCNS-2.json, canonical data-format-v2/question-bank-mcns2/question-bank-mcns2.json, .kimchi/docs/cns-sorting-report.md, .kimchi/docs/cns-sorting-stats.md.

grade.rationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.
